application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
decision_conditions: Reason : 1 - The information submitted pursuant to Condition 6 does not align with the Approved Energy Strategy, which achieved a 106% reduction, as required by the condition. As such, the submitted details fail to satisfy the requirements of Condition 6 and are contrary to London Plan Policy SI 2 and Local Plan Policy EQ1.

Reason : 2 - The information submitted pursuant to Condition 7 is insufficient to demonstrate compliance with the requirements of the condition. Accordingly, the requirements of Condition 7 have not been met, and the condition cannot be discharged. The submission is therefore contrary to London Plan Policy SI 5 and Local Plan Policy EQ2.

Reason : 3 - The information submitted pursuant to Condition 20 cannot be discharged as the associated Condition 19 has not been discharged. As such, the submitted details fail to satisfy the requirements of Condition 20 and are contrary to the Non-Statutory Technical Standards for Sustainable Drainage Systems, the National Planning Policy Framework, London Plan policies SI 12 and SI 13 (together with associated guidance to these policies) and Local Plan Policy EQ3.
description: Details of condition 6 Part B, C and D (Energy strategy) condition 7 (Water efficiency) condition 8 (Sustainable sourcing of materials) and condition 20 (Evidence of Drainage) submitted pursuant to planning permission 00722/ADJ60/P2 (P/2024/0044) date 27/02/2024 for Variation of conditions 2 (approved plans), 6 (energy strategy), 9 (obscure glazing) and 17 (refuse and recycling storage) of planning permission 00722/ADJ60/P1 approved 02/02/2023 for erection of a two storey building incorporating two one bedroom flats following the demolition of the existing four garages.
